properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated December 7, [1949], en route to St. Louis; includes description of meeting with J.T.T. [Juan Trippe] about separating the Pan American Airways hotel division from the airline, a request that Bixby lead it, and the conclusion.
